## Sea Spider (CR 11)

**XP** 12,800  
 NE Huge magical beast (aquatic)  
 **Init** +7; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +15  
 

**Defense**

 
 **AC** 25, touch 12, flat-footed 21 (+1 dodge, +3 Dex, +13 natural, -2 size)  
 **hp** 210 (15d10+60)  
 **Fort** +15, **Ref** +12, **Will** +6  
 

**Offense**

 
 **Speed** swim 90 ft.  
 **Melee** bite +19 (2d6+5 plus 1d4 acid plus grab), 4 slams +18 (1d8+5)  
 **Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
 **Special Attacks** swallow whole (1d8+5 plus 1d8 acid damage, AC 16, 14 hp)  
 

**Statistics**

 
 **Str** 20, **Dex** 16, **Con** 18, **Int** 6, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 11  
 **Base Atk** +15; **CMB** +22 (+26 grapple); **CMD** 36 (48 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** Cleave, Combat Reflexes, Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Skill Focus (Perception), Skill Focus (Stealth), Weapon Focus (bite), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility.*  
 **Skills** Perception +15, Stealth +6 (+14 when floating on the surface), Swim +18; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Stealth when floating on the surface  
 **Languages** Aquan  
   


  

**Ecology**

 
  **Environment** any aquatic  
 **Organization** solitary  
 **Treasure** none
